name: Feni
source: NASA POWER daily point API, community AG
powerProductVersion: FLASHFLUX, SYN1DEG, SRB, GEOSIT, MERRA2, POWER
fillValueHandling: header fill_value and -999 converted to NaN

method.onset: Onset v2: first wet day (≥ 1 mm) in DOY 121–270 whose 5-day rainfall reaches this point's own June–September mean 5-day rainfall over 2001–2025, with no 10-day period under 5 mm in the 30 days after.
method.onsetDefinition: Onset definition v2 (local-relative 5-day accumulation, adapted from Moron & Robertson 2014)
method.onsetRejected: Definition v1 (the originally specified rule: first day in DOY 145–270 with a 7-day sum >= 20 mm, >= 4 wet days, and no 7-day dry spell in the following 30 days) was measured on these same cached POWER series and returns the window floor in 51–89% of years at the six demo farms, because Bengal pre-monsoon convection already clears 20 mm in 7 days by late May. A censored metric cannot express a shift, so v1 is kept in the code only to report that censoring.
method.threshold: The 5-day threshold is this point's own mean 5-day rainfall over Jun 1–Sep 30 of 2001–2025, computed from the same POWER series (see onset.local_threshold). Both eras are compared against this one fixed local yardstick, so the era test measures a change in arrival order, not an absolute date.
method.eras: Era A 2001–2012 vs era B 2013–latest complete year; two-sided Mann-Whitney U on the per-year onset DOYs (or on the per-year indicator).
method.trends: Mann-Kendall with tie-corrected Var(S) and normal approximation; Theil-Sen slope; complete calendar years only (>= 350 days of data).
method.trendWindow: Rainfall and heat-day trends are computed over 2001–latest complete year, NOT 1981–2025, because POWER PRECTOTCORR is not homogeneous over the full record (Pettitt change point, quality.precipHomogeneity).
method.homogeneity: Pettitt (1979) rank-based change-point test, own implementation, on annual totals (full record and analysis window) and on annual mean T2M_MAX.
method.crossCheck: CHIRPS v2.0 daily 0.25° (Climate Hazards Center UCSB / USGS; Funk et al. 2015, Sci Data 2:150066) at the nearest grid cell, read from local files downloaded 2026-09-30. CHIRPS blends NOAA CPC satellite IR with station gauges; it is NOT a NASA or Space Agency Partner product, and it is not homogeneous in the same way POWER is, so it is the tie-breaker for the rainfall trend.
method.moisture: GWETROOT is POWER's modelled root-zone wetness (MERRA-2), not a SMAP retrieval. SMAP L4 soil moisture and NDVI are still demo fixtures.
caveats: POWER PRECTOTCORR steps upward inside the 1981–2025 record (source changes in the product), so the 1981–2025 annual-rainfall trend is an artefact and is not published as a climate signal. Each pack's quality.precipHomogeneity carries the Pettitt change point and step; metrics.rainfallTrendPctPerDecade is computed over 2001–latest only and is flagged when a change point falls inside that window. crossCheck re-states the same statistics from CHIRPS.

Onset v2 inherits that caution: the 5-day threshold is calibrated on 2001–2025 POWER, and a precipitation step inside 2001–2025 moves detections, so an 'earlier onset' from POWER must be read next to crossCheck.onset before it is believed.

Temperature side: POWER's own T2M/T2M_MAX also drifts (1981–1990 mean T2M at farm-12 is 26.38 °C against 25.42 °C for 2016–2025; a hand-run ERA5 spot check for 1985 at the same coordinates gave 25.28 °C), so a falling heat-day count is not evidence that heat has eased. quality.tempMaxHomogeneity states the test result.

onset.ruleLabel: Onset definition v2 (local-relative 5-day accumulation, adapted from Moron & Robertson 2014)
onset.rule: Onset v2: first wet day (≥ 1 mm) in DOY 121–270 whose 5-day rainfall reaches this point's own June–September mean 5-day rainfall over 2001–2025, with no 10-day period under 5 mm in the 30 days after.
onset.thresholdText: 5-day rainfall ≥ local Jun–Sep mean (2001–2025), no break ≥ 10 days under 5 mm
onset.thresholdBasis: this point's mean 5-day rainfall over Jun–Sep 2001–2025 (POWER PRECTOTCORR)
onset.caution: POWER precipitation has a Pettitt change point at 2015 inside the 2001–2025 window this onset was calibrated and compared on, so part of the measured shift is the precipitation product stepping, not the monsoon arriving. Read onset.shiftDays together with crossCheck.onset.

legacyV1.rule: 7-day sum >= 20 mm from DOY 145, >= 4 wet days, no 7-day dry spell after
legacyV1.reason: measured on this same series; the censoring rate is why v2 replaced it

metrics.rainfallTrendCaution: caution: POWER precipitation has source changes (Pettitt change point 2015); see crossCheck

homogeneity.implication: No significant step detected in this series over the tested windows.

agreement.note: mae/bias are POWER minus CHIRPS (mm for annual totals, days for onset DOYs)

rainfallTrend.reason: POWER PRECTOTCORR has a significant Pettitt change point inside the 2001–2025 analysis window; CHIRPS does not.

onsetShift.reason: POWER PRECTOTCORR has a significant Pettitt change point inside the 2001–2025 analysis window; CHIRPS does not.

precipHomogeneity.implication: A step inside the analysis window means any trend or era difference computed across it is partly the product changing, not the climate changing. Report it with the caution and prefer the independent cross-check.

tempMaxHomogeneity.implication: A step inside the analysis window means any trend or era difference computed across it is partly the product changing, not the climate changing. Report it with the caution and prefer the independent cross-check.

quality.smapSoilMoisture: not retrieved — POWER GWETROOT used instead, labelled
quality.soil: not retrieved — SoilGrids values are demo fixtures

boundary.method: shapely representative_point (pole of inaccessibility, inside the polygon)
